hero.title: Welcome to Better Dagupan
hero.subtitle: The volunteer-run community portal for the City of Dagupan. Find information, access government services, and follow what the city government publishes.

services.title: Popular Services
services.description: Access official government services quickly and easily. Find what you need for citizenship, business, education, and more.

footer.copyright: Better Dagupan - Source code is covered by the repository license. Individual records and source materials retain the terms of the body that published them.

joinUs.stripSubtitle: Help build the future of the Philippines and governance through technology
joinUs.bannerSubtitle: Help build the future of the Philippines and governance through technology.

data.title: Real-Time Data Services
data.description: Access up-to-date information on weather conditions and foreign exchange rates across the Philippines.
data.weatherDescription: Get current weather conditions and forecasts for major cities across the Philippines. Plan your day with accurate temperature readings and weather alerts.
data.forexDescription: Track foreign exchange rates from Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). Convert currencies and view historical rate trends for major world currencies.

promotion.philsysDescription: Register for your Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) ID card today. The national ID serves as a single government-issued identification document for all citizens.

government.title: Local Government of the City of Dagupan
government.description: Learn about the key offices, councils, and local units that make up the City Government of Dagupan.
government.executiveDescription: Led by the Mayor, responsible for implementing city policies, programs, and ordinances.
government.legislativeDescription: Composed of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, responsible for making local laws.
government.barangaysDescription: Local government units within the city, led by elected officials who manage community-level services and programs.
government.departmentsDescription: City departments and agencies responsible for specific areas of governance.
government.electedofficialsDescription: The elected leadership of the Executive and Legislative branches, responsible for policy implementation and law-making.
government.directoryDescription: Find contact information for government officials, agencies, and offices at national and local levels.

disclaimer.short: {{portal}} is an independent, community-led project. It is not the official website of the City Government of {{lgu}}.
disclaimer.noticeBody: {{portal}} is built and maintained by volunteers. It is not the official website of the City Government of {{lgu}}, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency.
disclaimer.officialSiteLabel: Visit the official {{lgu}} City Government website

emptyState.title: Not yet available
emptyState.body: Verified {{lgu}} information has not been added yet. This section is part of the portal's structure and will be filled once records are sourced from the City Government of {{lgu}} and verified.

civic.historicalSpellingNote: Recorded from a superseded page and shown for searchability. It is not evidence of the current official name.
civic.notVerifiedHint: Better Dagupan has not found an authoritative source for this detail yet. It is not a statement that the information does not exist.

barangays.title: Barangays
barangays.count: {{count}} barangays of the {{lgu}}, as published by the Philippine Statistics Authority.
barangays.noMatches: No barangay name matches that search.
barangays.officialsNotVerified: The officials of this barangay are not published here yet.
barangays.officialsNotVerifiedWhy: The only city-government roster found covers the 2018–2020 term, so publishing it would present former officials as current ones. Names will be added once a current source is verified.

departments.title: City Departments
departments.count: {{count}} offices of the {{lgu}}, as published by the city government.
departments.searchPlaceholder: Search by office name (e.g. City Treasury)…
departments.noMatches: No office name matches that search.
departments.headNotVerified: The head of this office is not published here yet.
departments.headNotVerifiedConflict: The city government names a different person for this office on different official pages, and none of them is dated, so there is no basis for choosing between them. A name will appear once a current source settles it.
departments.headNotVerifiedUncorroborated: Only one official city page names anyone for this office, which is not enough to establish that the appointment is current. A name will appear once a second source confirms it.

unavailable.title: Legislative records are not published yet
unavailable.message: Ordinances and resolutions of the {{body}} have not been added to this portal yet. Check the official website of the {{lgu}} in the meantime.

reportError.seoDescription: Tell the {{portal}} volunteers about information on the portal that is wrong or out of date.
reportError.title: Report an error
reportError.intro: Found something on {{portal}} that is wrong or out of date? Let us know, and a volunteer will check it against the official source.
reportError.ruleSource: We publish a fact only when a primary government source states it, such as the City Government of {{lgu}}, the Philippine Statistics Authority, or another national agency.
reportError.ruleLink: Include a link to where the correct information is officially published. Without a source, the page cannot be changed.
reportError.ruleReview: A volunteer checks the source before anything on the page changes.
reportError.rulePublic: Reports are public. Do not include personal information such as your phone number or home address.
reportError.githubBody: Opens a short form on GitHub. You will need a free GitHub account.
reportError.githubActionLabel: Open the correction form on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
reportError.emailBody: Email the volunteers at {{email}}. Say which page is wrong, what the correct information is, and where it is officially published.
reportError.sourceNoteLinkLabel: Report an error in this information

cityNotices.description: Bid invitations, awards and other procurement notices the {{lgu}} publishes on its own website.
cityNotices.unavailableTitle: The city's notices could not be loaded

cityNotices.noMatchesMessage: Try a different search or procurement mode.
cityNotices.attribution: Titles and links come from the {{lgu}}'s website and are shown as published.

committees.withheldConflict: Official sources disagree about who chairs some committees, and nothing establishes which assignments are current, so none is shown here. They will appear once a current source settles them.
committees.withheldUncorroborated: Only one source lists committee assignments, which is not enough to establish that they are current. They will appear once a second source confirms them.

population.title: Population Profile
population.description: Census population of the {{lgu}} and its barangays, as counted by the Philippine Statistics Authority.
population.barangayYearsNotVerified: No barangay breakdown is shown for {{years}}
population.barangayYearsNotVerifiedHint: Better Dagupan has not yet verified a PSA barangay table for that census. The citywide count for that year is shown on the Citywide view.
population.tableCaption: Census population of the {{lgu}} by census year
population.readCity: Each figure is a PSA census count at the census reference date ({{dates}}). The censuses are not evenly spaced, so compare growth using the PSA's annual rates rather than the slope between points. None of these figures is an estimate or a projection.
population.readBarangays: Barangay counts are shown for {{years}}, the censuses whose PSA barangay tables have been verified. Barangay names follow the current PSGC; for each census the barangay figures add up exactly to the city total.

hotlines.title: Emergency hotlines
hotlines.cityNotVerified: No city hotline is verified yet
hotlines.cityWithheld: Some numbers the city lists are not shown yet
hotlines.cityWithheldHint: Better Dagupan lists a number only when two independent official lists state it. Numbers the city publishes in a single list, or gives to two different offices, are held back until a second source settles them. It is not a statement that those lines do not exist.

history.title: History of {{lgu}}
history.intro: Legal milestones in the life of the city, each taken from the official text of the law or order it rests on. Dates are given as precisely as those documents state them.
history.earlierNotVerifiedHint: This timeline begins with the 1947 city charter because that is where Better Dagupan has found official texts. Accounts of the town's earlier history and of its name have not yet been matched to an authoritative source. It is not a statement that that history is unknown.
